messages:
oncall-bot: Paging: High 5xx rate observed from inference-prod (us-west-2). Error rate jumped from 0.2% to ~18% at 03:12 UTC. Triggered by latency-slo alert and request-error alert. Docs: <https://redwood.internal/incidents/1790004512>
Alex: I'm on it. digging into recent deploys first. any recent rollouts? :eyes:
Jamal: No deploys from infra team in the last 6 hours. I see a spike in memory pressure on several titan nodes tho. pushing logs to the channel.
Alex: grabbing logs, will tail prod agent now
Alex: `kubectl logs -n inference inference-prod-5f8d --since=30m | grep ERROR | tail -n 50`
Alex: Logs show repeated OOM-ish traces from the runtime: `KV cache allocation failed` around 03:10-03:13.
Sophia: That matches the autoscaler activity in the last 30m — scaled down a pool, then scaled back up. Could be eviction thrash.
Maria: Tagging oncall infra: @Jamal are we sure autoscaler didn't remove warm nodes with pinned models?
Jamal: Checking. Autoscaler events:
```
2026-03-15T03:05:21Z scaler: removed node gpu-pool-3 (idle)
2026-03-15T03:09:47Z scaler: removed node gpu-pool-2 (idle)
2026-03-15T03:11:05Z scaler: added node gpu-pool-4
```
Jamal: Looks like warm nodes were reclaimed between 03:05-03:09. The runtime immediately attempted to rehydrate KV caches when requests hit, spiking memory.
Alex: mitigation idea: enable emergency fallback to smaller-quantized model variants and block autoscaler for 10m to let caches warm.
Sophia: agree. I'm going to flip route policy to fallback -> quant-small and set autoscale hold. executing now.
Sophia: `POST /admin/route/production/fallback` -> payload `{"fallback_model":"quant-small-v2"}` (success)
Sophia: `PATCH /admin/autoscaler?hold=true&duration=600` (success)
oncall-bot: Incident state: mitigation applied by Sophia at 03:18 UTC. Error rate dropping.
Alex: Error rate down to 1.8% at 03:23. Latency still a little high but acceptable. Starting to collect impact and timeline for postmortem.
Maria: Customer-facing note: support should prepare brief with affected tenants and window 03:10-03:23 UTC. @Oliver can you take lead on customer impact assessment?
Oliver: On it. I'll pull tenant logs and surface any degraded SLAs. ETA 1h.
Jamal: Ops action: pin warm nodes so autoscaler won't reclaim them for the next 24h. I'll create a temp label and policy.
Jamal: `kubectl label node gpu-pool-4 redwood:keep-warm=true` (done)
Alex: Thanks. Also want to make sure KV cache rehydrate paths are instrumented. I'll file an infra task.

---

Alex: Quick sync: we should schedule a 45m postmortem tomorrow to capture timeline, root cause, action items. Proposed time: 2026-03-16 16:00 UTC. Works for everyone?
Jamal: Works.
Maria: Works for me.
Sophia: Can do.
Oliver: can attend.

Alex: I'll create the postmortem draft doc and start the RCA timeline in the document. Using template: https://redwood.internal/postmortem-template
Alex: initial timeline (will refine):
- 03:05 UTC: autoscaler removed idle nodes from gpu-pool-2 and gpu-pool-3
- 03:09 UTC: traffic causing model rehydrates; KV cache allocation failures begin
- 03:11 UTC: oncall-bot triggered paging alert (5xx rate)
- 03:12 UTC: Alex acknowledged and started investigation
- 03:15 UTC: mitigation: route fallback -> quant-small applied
- 03:18 UTC: autoscaler hold applied (10m), caches begin to warm
- 03:23 UTC: error rate returned to baseline

Sophia: can you add the scaling events metrics graph? I'll attach SLO history and trace samples.
Alex: done, attached perf snippets in the doc. (link: https://redwood.internal/pm/1790004512-draft)

---

Alex: Action items (initial):
- JAMAL: create autoscaler policy to avoid removing nodes with pinned models or active caches (owner: Jamal) — due 2026-03-20
- SOPHIA: add rehydrate metrics and alert for KV cache allocation failures (owner: Sophia) — due 2026-03-18
- OLIVER: customer impact summary + tenant list + support template (owner: Oliver) — due 2026-03-15 14:30 UTC
- ALEX: draft RCA and submit for peer review (owner: Alex) — due 2026-03-16 12:00 UTC
- MARIA: prepare postmortem communication for external stakeholders (owner: Maria) — due 2026-03-16 18:00 UTC

Jamal: I'll open a tracking board ticket and link to this thread. ticket: RDW-INC-4219
Alex: please add estimated risk of regression if we change autoscaler defaults. keep it conservative.

Maria: Planning review process: Alex will upload a first-pass RCA doc, then 48h peer review from infra/serving team, then sign-off by Eng Ops lead. If no objections after 48h, auto-approve.
Sophia: can we get a second reviewer from research/ML? tagging @Maya (not in thread) — please review quant fallback impacts.

Oliver: customer impact: initial check shows 12 production tenants saw increased error rates, 3 of them had request timeouts that could hit SLO thresholds. Pulling logs now and will upload csv.
Oliver: uploaded: https://redwood.internal/support/1790004512-impact.csv

Alex: Draft RCA PR created: https://git.redwood/reports/rca/1790004512
- PR includes timeline, contributing factors, mitigation, short-term fixes, long-term proposals.

Jamal: Reviewing PR now. quick note: add heap usage heatmap for the affected nodes.
Sophia: added comment to PR re: potential improvement: pre-warm pool and conservative autoscaler cooldown.
Maria: once PR is updated, ping this thread for peer review. aim to get sign-off by 2026-03-18 EOD.

Alex: Updated PR with heap heatmap and autoscaler change proposal. pinging reviewers: @Jamal @Sophia @Maria
Jamal: looked through, leaving a few inline comments about testing plan.
Sophia: LGTM pending test plan.
Maria: Approved.

Alex: Marking RCA as sign-off pending Eng Ops lead final check. tagging @Rita (not in thread) via email.

oncall-bot: Incident automatically moved to Postmortem queue (ID: PM-1790004512). Reminder: postmortem must be published within 7 days.

Alex: Closing the incident thread for live mitigation. All follow-ups are tracked in PM-1790004512 and RDW-INC-4219. Thanks everyone :tada:
